items.context: AI Applications department; owns architecture, deployment, and AI quality for the real-time AI interpretation platform Abestar Live and existing translation products, and designed the team's AI-agent workflow
jobDesc: Led Abestar Live from POC to production: real-time speech recognition feeding LLM translation and correction across six languages; staging load test held 10 concurrent sessions of 50 listeners each.

Prompts are versioned in one place and every change runs a fixed-corpus translation eval and cost measurement first; switching correction to explicit caching cut measured cost per session-hour by 58–76%.

Designed the team's AI-agent workflow: a card or comment in Asana is dispatched to a Claude Code agent automatically, and MRs are reviewed by AI against one shared code standard, then tiered so low-risk changes auto-merge and sensitive ones wait for a human.
Unified CI/CD templates across 6 projects: develop auto-deploys to staging, production releases are triggered manually from version tags, with blue-green deploys for zero-downtime switches.
Built centralized Grafana monitoring (metrics, logs, probes, 23 alert rules) and ran OWASP security scans across four repos.

items.context: Dating and social startup; sole engineer across the Flutter app, NestJS backend, and deployment
jobDesc: Brought AI into the development process and shipped 6 Claude features, two of them in paid tiers.
Added subscription auto-renewal and failed-payment retries; monthly revenue went from NT$210K to NT$380K.
Rewrote queries and added indexes for a 180ms API average; monthly cloud spend went from US$1,200 to US$400.
Moved LLM calls off the API hot path through SQS so AI can never block payments or matching.
Built a Python RAG support agent that hands off to a human when confidence is low; set up GitHub Actions CI/CD and shipped to iOS and Android in about six weeks.

items.context: Game and live-streaming platform; joined in 2020 as a backend engineer, engineering manager from January 2023
jobDesc: Led an 11-person cross-functional team (4 backend, 5 frontend, 2 QA) and owned 12 products from design to launch.
Designed the microservice architecture carrying a peak of a thousand transactions and orders per second, event-driven with Kafka and cached in Redis.
Set up the release checklist and release process, cutting release errors by 70%.
Built monitoring and logging with troubleshooting SOPs, improving problem isolation efficiency by 50%.
Made design review and code review the shared development standard across product lines.
As a backend engineer: refactored an unmaintained legacy system into layered modules and was lead backend on a blockchain fair-random-number platform.

items.context: Software consultancy; responsible for 7 client systems
jobDesc: Delivered seven client systems from zero — lending, video streaming, equipment dispatch, e-commerce — owning schema and API design.
Built the video platform on AWS (Lambda with FFmpeg transcoding) and replaced manual releases with automated deployment.
Built unit and functional tests to guard the regression surface.
Chose the stack per client environment (C#, Node.js, React, Salesforce).
Served as first point of contact for new hires, maintaining environment setup and project docs.
